fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reports on free-speech controversy involving radio commentator Barry Gray; renewed allegations against Dr. T. Earl Moore (dubbed the “Torture Doctor”) and associates; discussion of Florida Keys oil drilling prospects; commentary on labor tactics and press freedom following a Florida Supreme Court picketing ruling; debate over proposed Miami water-rate increases and calls for a referendum; public health coverage including a Florida campaign to find infectious syphilis cases; and reprinted material urging congressional scrutiny of extreme right-wing influence in press, radio, and lobbying.
